title: Get Out
vibeSentence: Dread wrapped in civility; discomfort that lingers.
reasoning: Get Out's power lies in escalating dread rooted in genuine social horror. The film prioritizes eudaimonic meaning (race-conscious social commentary) and psychological richness (perspective-broadening genre subversion) over hedonic pleasure, making discomfort the point. Chris's agency and ultimate victory prevent overwhelming helplessness, but sustained tension keeps arousal high. The man-in-a-hole trajectory ends triumphantly, yet the viewing experience remains intentionally unsettling—designed to provoke rather than comfort.
